benefits: ₹ 1,00,000, in two installments of ₹ 50,000 each, as immediate relief assistance for the family (legal heir) of the missing fisherman. ﻿ Disbursal Initially, 50% will be extended within 3 months from the date of receipt of the application from the family (legal heir). benefits: Group A: 7.5%, subject to a limit of ₹ 1,00,00,000/-, Group B: 10%, subject to a limit of ₹ 1,00,00,000/-, Group C: 15%, subject to a limit of ₹ 1,20,00,000/-, Group D: 20%, subject to a limit of ₹ 1,50,00,000/-. The project should be covered by a detailed feasibility report/project prepared for the purpose. The project should have been approved and sanctioned by a Central Financial Institution or Commercial Banks or State Financial Institutions. Proof of overhauling/ repairs to the engine/hull during the notified fishing ban period.
